Prayer:

Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India
to issue a Writ of Mandamus, directing the respondents to constitute a
special committee consisting of experts to examine all the Oil Pockets, Oil
Products, being marketed across the State whether they are consumable within 
the time stipulated by this Court.

! For Petitioner : Mr.S.Malaikani
For Respondents 1to3: Mr.P.Paulpandi

For Respondents 4&5 : Mr.M.Govindan, 
 Special Government Pleader :ORDER  [Order of the Court was made by K.K.SASIDHARAN, J.]

The petitioner filed this Writ Petition in pro bono publico to direct the respondents to constitute a Special Committee consisting of Experts to examine all the Oil Pockets, Oil Products marketed across the State and decide as to whether they are fit for human consumption.
2. The adulteration in Edible oil without adherence to the Food Safety and Standards Act and labelling and mislabelling made the petitioner to file this Writ Petition.

In view of the larger public interest shown by the petitioner, we have directed the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration to ascertain the feasibility of issuing appropriate guidelines and constitute a Monitoring Committee.

3. The Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai, pursuant to our direction,
by order dated 31 August, 2017, constituted a State Level Committee under the Chairmanship of the Deputy Director with designated Officers from Salem, Erode, Namakkal, Virudhunagar, Madurai and Tuticorin, as Members.

entities.text: Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration, Chennai
entities.label: RESPONDENT

sentences.text: The Committee is obliged to check/scrutinize the various brands of edible oil available in the market for safety, standards and labelling as per FSSA Act and Rules.

The Commissioner conducted a review meeting on 03 August, 2017, and district wise list of oil brands/companies has been collected and consolidated at the State level and the list would be made available to the Committee.
The District Officers would be called upon to lift the samples of all major oil brands and send a report to the State Level Committee on the test results and labelling discrepancies.
The Committee would review the issues identified from time to time by the Field Officers and based on complaints received from public.
Thereafter, appropriate action would be taken against the edible oil manufacturers those who are marketing the oil in violation of the provisions of FSSA Act and Rules.
The Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration has also taken action for creating awareness on edible oil.

The specific awareness was created among the consumers to check the labels, ingredients, colouring agents, manufacturing date, expiry date/best before date, FSSAI Logo, storage conditions for food items and purpose/use.

The consumers are at liberty to prefer complaints to the State Level Committee by using Whats-app No.94440 42322.
4.

In view of the action taken by the Commissioner of Food Safety and Drug Administration,
